tool_input.paragraphs:
["Overall credibility check result: not passed. For step s1 (static), reaction balance passed, so the applied load is balanced by the support reactions. Mesh quality also passed, with no inverted elements and very few badly shaped ones.","The maximum von Mises stress convergence check did not pass. The peak stress grows with each refinement, from {{s1.conv2.level0}} on the first mesh to {{s1.conv2.level1}} on the second and {{s1.conv2.level2}} on the third. This suggests a stress singularity, such as a sharp corner or point load. The reported maximum von Mises stress of {{s1.vm_max_mpa}} (away from constrained faces) is therefore not converged and should not be used as a design basis. It is not a reliable basis for comparison with the yield strength of {{s1.strength_mpa}}.","The maximum displacement convergence check passed. The values are {{s1.conv3.level0}}, {{s1.conv3.level1}} and {{s1.conv3.level2}} on the three meshes, and the levels differ very little. The maximum displacement of {{s1.u_max_mm}} is therefore stable with respect to the mesh. This does not make the stress result credible.","No safety factor is given, because the credibility checks did not pass.","Limitations: the model is linear elastic with small deformation, with no contact, residual stress or surface hardening. Stresses near constrained and loaded faces come from idealized boundary conditions, and the maximum stress evaluation avoided those regions. Stress at sharp corners increases with mesh refinement (a theoretical singularity), so it should not be used directly for design."],
"suggestions": ["Have an engineer identify the location of the maximum stress and check whether it lies at a sharp corner or point load.", "If the geometry has a sharp corner there, add the real fillet radius to the model and refine the mesh locally around it.", "If the peak comes from a point load, replace it with a distributed load over the real contact area.", "Rerun the stress convergence study after these changes and confirm that the peak stress stabilizes across mesh levels.", "Until the stress check passes, use only the displacement result and treat the stress as unverified.", "Provide fillet radii and real load-application details so that a safety factor can be evaluated later."]}
